Subject: Arcadia briefing — release window conflict & proposed fallback slots

Hi Samira —

Gartner (Ellen Park) reached out asking for a 45-minute customer briefing to support an upcoming vendor profile. They asked for an executive + engineeringops presence and some production performance slides. Ellen suggested week of Sep 19–25.

Quick asks:
- Can Arcadia do a 45-minute call that week? If so please indicate 2 preferred windows (ET).
- Heads-up: I believe you have a planned release the week of Sep 20–22 (per previous sync). If that's a hard blackout we should give Gartner alternate dates.
- I’ve attached a first-pass agenda (briefing_agenda_v1.docx) — it’s intentionally light on metrics pending your sign-off and any legal constraints.

If release is a hard constraint, we can offer a short exec-only slot + deferred ops deep-dive after the release, or provide sanitized metrics snapshots in-lieu of live console access. Need guidance on which you prefer so I can propose times to Gartner.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Arcadia briefing — release window conflict & proposed fallback slots

Jordan — thanks for the heads up. We can do a customer briefing but there is a scheduled major release and freeze window at Arcadia from Sep 20 00:00 ET through Sep 22 23:59 ET. That is a hard blackout for anything that might require engineering time or production access.

Available windows for an exec + engineering call on the requested week are:
- Mon Sep 19 11:00–12:00 ET
- Fri Sep 23 13:00–14:00 ET (we can do exec + a single ops engineer)
- Mon Sep 26 10:00–11:00 ET (preferred if Gartner can push)

We can sign any standard reference permission but legal asked me to confirm whether Gartner will request call recordings or raw production metrics. If they want recordings or granular logs we need to route through our legal/compliance team first.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Arcadia Therapeutics
samira.khan@arcadiahealth.com

Confirming Gartner would prefer a single 45-minute briefing. Recording is acceptable if Arcadia signs the standard reference release — we do not require raw logs; sanitized aggregate metrics are fine. We use these briefings to validate use cases for our research note; no vendor-provided scripts are required.

Can we please aim for one of the following slots in Eastern Time:
- Thu Sep 23 11:00–11:45 ET
- Fri Sep 24 11:00–11:45 ET
- Mon Sep 26 10:00–10:45 ET

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Arcadia briefing — release window conflict & proposed fallback slots

Marissa / Vivek —

Heads-up: Arcadia has a hard release blackout Sep 20–22; Gartner proposed Sep 23 or Sep 24 or Sep 26. Samira suggested Sep 26 is preferred, but Gartner needs something earlier if possible. Options I see:

1) Push to Sep 24 (Arcadia can spare an exec + single ops engineer; engineering agrees to provide sanitized charts only)
2) Keep Sep 26 (safe, but delays inclusion in Gartner’s timeline)
3) Exec-only on Sep 23 with a shorter Q&A; follow with an ops-only deep-dive after release.

Pros/cons: earlier slot helps vendor note timing; later slot avoids release risk. If we go with sanitized charts we should prepare a short runbook describing what we will and will not share (no PII, no full logs). Samira also shared a release calendar — attaching the calendar stub so you can see the blackout (arcadia_release_calendar.ics).

Request: please confirm preferred fallback (1/2/3) and whether we can offer sanitized charts. Also worth deciding if we want PR/comms looped in — this will be public-facing research.

Thanks —
Jordan

Attachment: arcadia_release_calendar.ics (attachment stub)
